setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through the test MIDI device: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in C major. The Masks page (Channel tasks, then Masks) is open on Note. The channel's Note mask default is 67 (G3), step 1 has its own mask 72 and step 2 has 74, so the MIDI strip reads 72, 74, 67, 67.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4), press K2 and release. Step 1 falls back to the channel default, 67, but step 2 keeps its 74. Play, then stop: the strip reads 67, 74, 67, 67.
steps.title: Clear step 1 only

steps.caption: Hold step 1 again, hold K1 and press K2, then release. With a step held, only that step is cleared, even while K1 is down, and step 1 has nothing left to clear. Play, then stop: the strip still reads 67, 74, 67, 67.
steps.title: A held step wins over the shift clear

steps.caption: With no step held, hold K1 and press K2. Every step exception clears but the channel default stays. Play, then stop: the strip reads 67, 67, 67, 67.
steps.title: Clear every step mask on the channel

title: Clear a note mask without clearing its neighbour
